title: 第7章 奖励已发放请注意查收第8章 痛苦debuff是催化剂
slug: 幕后黑手我的词条邪到发癫
content_zh:
冯睦深吸一口气，弯腰俯身，首先从书包里掏出一卷床单平铺在地上。
然后，冯睦扒掉尸体的衣裳叠好放在一边，鞋子脱下来换到自己脚上。
接着，冯睦把尸体小心翼翼的搬到床单上，像裹木乃伊似的裹的严严实实。
最后，冯睦从书包里取出锤子。
哐哐的声音砸落，隔着衣服，声音略显闷沉。
放干血液脱掉水分，又被邪恶力量侵蚀过的尸体，跟正常的尸体是有区别的，触感更像是…..上辈子吃过的风干鸡。
肉很烂，容易与骨头脱离，骨头也脆，一砸就裂，再砸就碎了。
“跟脑海中，[血与铁献祭相关知识]描述的基本一致。”
冯睦尝试一下，确认尸体给出的反馈与新学的知识点相符，心头紧绷的弦才松了。
这是最关键的步骤，若是出了岔子，那他就只能换一种解法了，那个解法相对更耗时，也更麻烦。
好在，系统灌输入脑海的知识点是经得起实践验证的。
“男尸部分的收尾就剩单调的体力重复，而，女尸那边我则只需要一点点变动就可以，唔，争取午休时间搞完。”
冯睦收紧心神，一丝不苟的执行自己的计划。
中午没搞完。
下午放学后，冯睦不得不又在仓库耗了一个小时。
主要是任务量比冯睦预想的要大一些。
毕竟，哪怕尸体变成风干鸡，也绝非个轻松的活计，光重复抡锤就得上百次。
另外，处理现场痕迹，需要特别细致，比机械的体力重复还要累人。
“第一次，缺乏经验，下一次，我应该就能熟练许多，啊，我为什么会想着下一次啊，呸呸呸。”
冯睦翻窗而出，绕回教学楼厕所，在隔档里换回自己的鞋子，背上塞的鼓鼓囊囊的书包，慢悠悠的晃出学校。

这个点，操场上还有些稀稀疏疏准备离校的学生和老师，冯睦混在其中也不显眼。
回到家，家里就他和母亲两个人。
冯睦借口肚子不舒服，没吃晚饭就钻回自己屋子，将门从里面反锁上。
他坐在书桌前，抽出纸笔，一边仔细回忆一边将今日的行为，全都仔细的记录到纸上。
就像是考试后的对答案估分一样，冯睦对着记录，在脑海中一遍遍复盘模拟，最终才长长舒出一口气。
他没有把纸张撕碎扔垃圾桶，而是揉成一团，就着几颗铁珠子，硬生生吞进肚子里了。
真物理意义上的把秘密藏进肚子里！
“可以了，之后就是把对方的遗物和碎骨找地方处理掉就行了。”
冯睦瞥了眼书包，拉开拉链，掏出里面的衣服、鞋子、钱包、手机，羊角锤等。
想了想，他从衣柜里翻出个旧袋子，把衣服、鞋子、钱包都装进去扎口系好。
明天上学路上，他会找个地方掩埋掉。
扔外面垃圾桶是不可能的，下城九区可是有许多流浪汉，拾荒者，老头老太太，时不时就来垃圾桶“舔包”的。
手机，冯睦打算单独藏起来，说不定，以后还要用到。
至于书包里床单裹的“风干肉”，冯睦需要更慎重处理。
因为，单用羊角锤是无法彻底砸成骨灰，否则他可以一把扬了随风飘，现在不行，万一被人捡到碎骨，依稀还是能辨认出物种的。
埋掉也不保险。
冯睦不止一次在饭桌上，听到冯矩抱怨，哪哪小区饿疯了的野狗刨地挖出了人类的尸骨，给巡捕房增添了工作量。
说到底都怪那些捡垃圾的人类霸占了野狗的家园。
总之，家里住个捕头，冯睦有意无意间，培养出了反侦察意识。
“最重要是得感谢，上辈子3000集《名侦探柯南》的知识储备，奥利给~”

冯睦重新整理下书包，从抽屉里抽出沓试卷，压在床单上面，再用笔袋盖上。
content_en:
Feng Mu took a deep breath, bent over, and first took out a roll of sheets from his schoolbag and spread it flat on the ground.
Then, Feng Mu took off the clothes of the corpse and folded them aside. He took off his shoes and put them on his feet.
Then, Feng Mu carefully moved the body onto the sheets and wrapped it tightly like a mummy.
Finally, Feng Mu took out the hammer from his schoolbag.
There was a clanging sound, which was slightly muffled through the clothes.
The corpse that had been drained of blood and water and corroded by evil forces was different from a normal corpse. It felt more like... the dried chicken that I had eaten in my previous life.
The meat is very rotten and easily detaches from the bones. The bones are also brittle and will crack if you hit them and break if you hit them again.
"It's basically consistent with the [knowledge related to blood and iron sacrifice] described in my mind."
Feng Mu gave it a try and confirmed that the feedback given by the corpse was consistent with the newly learned knowledge points, and then the tension in his heart relaxed.
This is the most critical step. If something goes wrong, he will have to find another solution, which is relatively more time-consuming and troublesome.
Fortunately, the knowledge points instilled into the mind through the system can stand the test of practice.
"The finishing of the male corpse part is just monotonous physical repetition, while for the female corpse, I only need a little change. Well, I will try to finish it during my lunch break."
Feng Mu tightened his mind and executed his plan meticulously.
Not finished by noon.
After school in the afternoon, Feng Mu had to spend another hour in the warehouse.
The main reason was that the workload was larger than Feng Mu expected.
After all, even if the corpse is turned into dried chicken, it is by no means an easy job. Just repeat the hammering hundreds of times.
In addition, processing on-site traces requires special meticulousness, which is more tiring than mechanical repetitive physical work.
"The first time, I lacked experience. Next time, I should be much more skilled. Ah, why am I thinking about the next time, bah bah bah."
Feng Mu climbed out of the window, went back to the toilet in the teaching building, changed into his shoes in the stall, and slowly walked out of the school with the bulging schoolbag stuffed on his back.
At this point, there were still some scattered students and teachers preparing to leave school on the playground, and Feng Mu was not conspicuous among them.
When he returned home, he and his mother were the only two people at home.
Feng Mu excused his stomach discomfort, went back to his room without eating dinner, and locked the door from the inside.
He sat at his desk, took out a pen and paper, and carefully recorded all of today's actions on paper while recalling his thoughts.
Just like evaluating the answers after an exam, Feng Mu looked at the records and reviewed the simulation over and over in his mind, and finally let out a long sigh of relief.
Instead of tearing up the paper and throwing it into the trash can, he crumpled it into a ball and swallowed it with a few iron beads.
Hiding the secret in the stomach in a true physical sense!
"That's enough. Then we just need to find a place to dispose of the other party's relics and broken bones."
Feng Mu glanced at his schoolbag, opened the zipper, and took out the clothes, shoes, wallet, mobile phone, claw hammer, etc. inside.
After thinking about it, he took out an old bag from the closet, put his clothes, shoes, and wallet in it and tied it up.
He will find a place to bury it on his way to school tomorrow.
It is impossible to throw it out in the trash can. There are many homeless people, scavengers, and old men and women in District 9 of the Lower City, who come to the trash can from time to time to "lick their bags."
Feng Mu plans to hide the mobile phone alone, maybe it will be used in the future.
As for the "air-dried meat" wrapped in sheets in his schoolbag, Feng Mu needs to handle it more carefully.
Because the claw hammer alone cannot completely crush the ashes into ashes, otherwise he could just lift them up and let them drift in the wind. But that is not possible now. If someone picks up the broken bones, the species can still be vaguely identified.
It's not safe to bury it.
More than once at the dinner table, Feng Mu heard Feng Ju complain that hungry wild dogs in the neighborhood dug up human bones, adding to the workload of the patrol room.
After all, it's all those who pick up trash.Garbage humans have occupied the home of wild dogs.
In short, Feng Mu, knowingly or unknowingly, developed an anti-reconnaissance consciousness with a headhunter living at home.
"The most important thing is to thank Ollie for the knowledge reserve of 3,000 episodes of "Detective Conan" in his previous life~"
Feng Mu rearranged his school bag, took out a stack of test papers from the drawer, pressed them on top of the sheets, and covered them with a pencil case.
